title: A Survey on Federated Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain any benchmarks that measure aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on technical performance, and domain-specific applications in finance, medicine, code, math, and law.
findings: This paper is a technical survey on federated fine-tuning of large language models. It does not analyze, test, or discuss any aspects related to religion, faith, or religious bias. The focus is entirely on the technical challenges, methods, datasets, and applications (e.g., finance, biomedical, recommendation systems) of the FedLLM paradigm.
